phase: Phase C7 - remaining dynamics candidates on the real LRO arc: lunar solid tide (k2, k3), Moon 1PN (Schwarzschild), Venus and Jupiter third body - linear effect-size survey
written: 2026-11-01, after C6 / F3d and before any C7 code or number
motivation: The roadmap's Phase C dynamics list (relativistic 1PN, lunar solid tide k2, Venus and Jupiter, albedo/IR, box-wing SRP) is untested except albedo/IR (C6: does not explain F2p's K_SRP excess). F2's force model has none of these. The GL1800F label (python_port/data/gravity/gl1800f/jggrx_1800f_sha.lbl lines 31-34) states that the degree-2 and -3 coefficients do NOT include the permanent tide and gives k2 = 0.024223, k3 = 0.0163, so a GL1800F user must add the full tide; F2 does not. At 50 km the degree-2 Earth tide is of order 1e-7 m/s^2, several times the SRP

models.tide: elastic (no lag) induced potential of the Moon for each raising body j in {Earth, Sun} and degree n in {2 (k2 = 0.024223), 3 (k3 = 0.0163)}: U = k_n mu_j R^(2n+1) / (d_j^(n+1) r^(n+1)) P_n(cos theta), cos theta = r_hat . d_hat_j, R = 1738.0 km (GL1800F reference radius); a = grad U = k_n mu_j R^(2n+1) / d_j^(n+1) * r^-(n+2) [-(n+1) P_n(c) r_hat + P_n'(c) (d_hat - c r_hat)]
models.pn: Moon Schwarzschild term (IERS 2010 eq. 10.12, central body only): a = mu / (c^2 r^3) [(4 mu / r - v^2) r + 4 (r . v) v]
models.planets: indirect third-body point masses Venus (299) and Jupiter barycentre (5), Moon-centred: a = mu_j [(d_j - r)/|d_j - r|^3 - d_j/|d_j|^3]
models.inputs: Earth, Sun, Venus, Jupiter positions wrt the Moon from SPICE spkpos (J2000, NONE) on F3's 20 s grid, linearly interpolated to the RK4 nodes; GM from the loaded kernels (bodvrd) as F2 does; mu_moon from GL1800F

linear_method: as C6 run 3 (A3 + A4): forced variational columns along F3's cached F2p trajectory, forcing exact at every RK4 sub-step node, full N = 300 gravity gradient from C6's cache (lro_data/f3_cache/c6_gradients.npy); rows hx @ column; linearised batch about F2p with F3's priors (fit 260-262, predict 263). One column per candidate at its nominal (physical) size

experiments.E_TIDE: tide (Earth + Sun, k2 + k3) fixed at nominal, 15 parameters re-solved

scores: as C6: fit / 263 range and Doppler RMS, 263 chi2, share = (chi2_E0 - chi2_X) / (chi2_E0 - 3642.61), solved K_SRP, C_T, S_T; acceleration RMS / max / RIC split per candidate; column max position over 260-263

gates.G_UNIT: unit tests: tide acceleration equals a central finite difference of U to 1e-6 relative for n = 2 and 3; 1PN term radial for a circular orbit (r . v = 0) with magnitude mu/(c^2 r^2)(4 mu/r - v^2) to 1e-12; third-body term equals the closed form at a test point
gates.G_QUAD: the forced-column method reproduces the cached C_T column to <= 1e-3 of its max over the fit arc (C6 run 3 method; K column is not used here because its 1.07e-3 residual is the known omitted SRP gradient)
gates.G_E0: E0 reproduces F3's sigma = 0 263 chi2 69 899.79 to 1e-6 relative
gates.G_SIZE: per candidate: column max position over 260-263 <= 200 m (linear validity, F3b G_LIN); a candidate failing G_SIZE is NOT_QUALIFIED for the linear survey and goes to a nonlinear refit (C7-I)

hypotheses.H_TIDE: E_TIDE share >= 0.3 or E_TIDE lowers K_SRP by >= 0.03 m^2/kg

decision_rule: per candidate: G_UNIT, G_QUAD or G_E0 FAIL -> C7_NOT_QUALIFIED for all; G_SIZE FAIL -> that candidate C7_<X>_NONLINEAR_NEEDED; otherwise TIDE: H_TIDE -> C7_TIDE_MATERIAL else C7_TIDE_IMMATERIAL; PN and PLANETS: hypothesis true -> MATERIAL else IMMATERIAL
reading_rule: a MATERIAL or NONLINEAR_NEEDED candidate goes to an implementation step (study-level force term in F2's propagation + nonlinear refit, own predeclaration); IMMATERIAL candidates are closed for this arc
limitations_stated_in_advance: linear about F2p; elastic tide without lag or frequency dependence; the C6/F3d 1 % gradient-model gap applies to the columns (G_QUAD bounds it at the C_T column)
